title: On Determining the date without argument
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：determine　|　正文 338 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 determine 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the musician ① determined the date without argument at once, and every listener in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the musician ② determines the date without argument in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ determine the date without argument at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ determined the date without argument before — a line in the programme for December 1949 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Determining the date without argument at once, the musician said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the score at the far piano, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ determine the height of the hill exactly in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Determine the height of the hill exactly at once and never mention it again.

By 1962 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the programme, and a new listener from the next hall ⑧ determines the height of the hill exactly at once every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the piano, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ determined the date without argument again when nobody else would.

⑩ To determine the date without argument, my mother said in 1967, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the hall remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the hall forgets, somebody determines the date without argument in the rain again and somebody must determine the date without argument at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 决定（一般过去式 determined the date without argument：1955 年乐师头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 决定（一般现在 determines the date without argument：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 决定（不定式 to determine the date without argument：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 决定（过去完成时 had determined the date without argument：1949 年十二月的节目单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 决定（动名词 determining the date without argument 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 测定（determine the height of the hill exactly：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去测定把山高测得极准）
G. v. 测定（determine the height of the hill exactly：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 决定（后段两处：新来的听客照例 determines the height of the hill exactly，而母亲又一次 determined the date without argument）

items.q: to determine the date without argument
determined the date without argument before
determine the height of the hill exactly in the rain
determine the height of the hill exactly at once
determines the height of the hill exactly at once
determined the date without argument again
to determine the date without argument

answers.why: determine 意为“决定”，1955 年乐师二话不说地决定不打折扣地定了日子，那是音乐厅里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 determined。
determine 意为“决定”，自那以后乐师淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 determines。
determine 意为“决定”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯决定不打折扣地定了日子”，此处为不定式 to determine the date without argument。
determine 意为“决定”，节目单里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1962 年之前就有人决定过，故用过去完成时 had determined。
determine 意为“决定”，乐师说“决定不打折扣地定了日子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 determining the date without argument 作主语。
determine 意为“测定”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去测定把山高测得极准”，should ever 之后用原形 determine the height of the hill exactly。
determine 意为“测定”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻测定把山高测得极准（determine the height of the hill exactly at once），以后再也不要提起。
determine 意为“决定”，新来的听客每个夜晚都照例测定把山高测得极准，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 determines。
determine 意为“决定”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地决定不打折扣地定了日子，用一般过去式 determined 叙述。
determine 意为“决定”，结尾那句是母亲 1967 年的话：要决定不打折扣地定了日子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和音乐厅记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年，乐师二话不说地决定不打折扣地定了日子；音乐厅里每一个听客都说这是头一回。（determined the date without argument）
多年以后，乐师仍淋着雨做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（determines the date without argument）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯决定不打折扣地定了日子这件事本身。（to determine the date without argument）
早在 1949 年就有人决定不打折扣地定了日子，十二月那天节目单上的一行字就是证据。（had determined the date without argument）
乐师说过，二话不说地决定不打折扣地定了日子这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（determining the date without argument 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻测定把山高测得极准，以后再也不要提起。（determine the height of the hill exactly，祈使句）
answers: In 1955 the musician determined the date without argument at once, and every listener in the hall said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three nights on, the musician still determines the date without argument in the rain without being asked.
My mother said later that to determine the date without argument at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had determined the date without argument long before 1962, and the line in the programme for December proves it.
Determining the date without argument at once, the musician said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Determine the height of the hill exactly at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 determine 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the musician determined the date without argument at once, and nobody in the hall forgot it.
Even now the musician determines the date without argument in the rain whenever the hall asks.
Determining the date without argument at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever determine the height of the hill exactly in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new listener from the next hall determines the height of the hill exactly at once every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother determined the date without argument again, and the hall remembered that half.
